The cheaper fix is rotating the code: `cf workers secrets update FASTTRACK_ACCESS_CODE --worker fasttrack-learn --text "<new>" --type secret_text`, and that alone invalidates the exposed value. Given this is a shared credential guarding paid content, I would rotate rather than rewrite.

nodes.label: Astro security.checkOrigin is what blocks the cross-site code-login POST
nodes.norm_label: astro security.checkorigin is what blocks the cross site code login post
nodes.rationale: [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar-proyek-fasttrack/2026-10-01 - intent-lock-login-kode-akses-kaminari99 [ses_f062ae74dffeB6bx90cYk0Y6Kr].md:L11915] the only thing preventing a cross-site form POST, and I never wrote a CSRF token. The POST works only because Astro blocks cross-origin. If someone sets `security: { checkOrigin: false }` the code POST has zero CSRF defense. Also: any curl/scripted client must send Origin.

Re-pushing fixed it — but a controlled repeat of the same deploy did **not** reproduce it, so the cause is unverified and I've recorded it that way. I added a probe to `scripts/deploy-website.sh` that checks after every deploy and prints both candidate causes with the command that distinguishes them. Mitigated, not explained.

nodes.label: UNIQUE(email) collision forces an ON CONFLICT(email) clause in the Google callback
nodes.norm_label: unique email collision forces an on conflict email clause in the google callback
nodes.rationale: [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar-proyek-fasttrack/2026-10-01 - intent-lock-login-kode-akses-kaminari99 [ses_f062ae74dffeB6bx90cYk0Y6Kr].md:L18999] Login kode membuat baris `users` ber-email itu. Kalau orang yang sama lalu login Google, `callback.ts` meng-`INSERT` dengan `id = Google sub` dan email-nya sudah dipakai → **500**. Jadi ini akan menimpa justru orang yang paling butuh fitur ini. Karena itu `callback.ts` harus diubah, dan itu perubahan pertama ke file itu di proyek ini.

nodes.rationale: [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar-proyek-fasttrack/2026-10-01 - intent-lock-login-kode-akses-kaminari99 [ses_f062ae74dffeB6bx90cYk0Y6Kr].md:L19001] `email_entitlements.email` punya `COLLATE NOCASE`, tapi `users.email` tidak. Artinya email yang tidak dinormalisasi akan membuat **dua baris untuk satu orang** — identitasnya pecah diam-diam. Jadi kedua jalur wajib `trim().toLowerCase()`.
